vulnerability.category_l2: Relative path traversal: the static-file whitelist is applied to the raw PATH_INFO while the file server resolves dot segments and percent-encoding

critical_operation.description: Rack::Static#call takes PATH_INFO verbatim (line 124) and asks can_serve(path) whether the request may be served (line 126). can_serve delegates to route_file, which only checks that the raw string starts with one of the configured urls: prefixes (line 116). A request such as "/cgi/../config.ru" satisfies that prefix test, and percent-encoded dot segments can hide the traversal from it entirely. The same unmodified PATH_INFO is afterwards handed to the file server, which resolves ".." and percent-decoding, so the response can be any file under root:, not only those under the configured urls: prefixes. The traversal cannot escape root: because Rack::Files cleans the path and joins it with root, so the impact is read access to the rest of the root: tree. The 2.2.13 fix computes Utils.clean_path_info(Utils.unescape_path(path)) and authorizes with can_serve(actual_path), aligning the checked path with the served path. CWE-23.

entry_point.description: An HTTP request whose PATH_INFO begins with a configured urls: prefix and then contains dot segments or percent-encoded traversal, reaching Rack::Static as middleware.

source_crosscheck.notes: CVE record, NVD, OSV and the branch git history agree on CWE-23, the 7.5 High vector and the 2.2.13/3.0.14/3.1.12 fixed versions. The declared impacts go beyond the urls: whitelist but stay inside root:, since Rack::Files cleans the path before File.join. Upstream metadata defects are recorded rather than resolved: the CNA/NVD/OSV FIX reference names only 50caab74, which lives on main and first appears in v3.2.0, so it is not the commit that fixes any of the three listed releases (the backports are 873d39e6, 61f83f63 and 70cb3228); and OSV lists the version-bump commits df6c4735/340cd1f1/e8f47608 as fixed events and appends 50caab74 to the 3.1 range.

independent_corrections_accepted: Bounded impact: the served path can leave the urls: prefixes but cannot escape root:; the description and limitations now say so explicitly.

Fix-commit mapping: 50caab74 belongs to main and first appears in v3.2.0, not in 2.2.13/3.0.14/3.1.12; the per-branch backports 873d39e6 (2.2), 61f83f63 (3.0) and 70cb3228 (3.1) were verified and added.
OSV metadata: the version-bump commits are listed as fixed events and 50caab74 is appended to the 3.1 range; recorded as an upstream defect.

limitations: Single-reviewer dossier; not eligible for data/vulnerabilities.jsonl yet.
No HTTP request was executed; the traversal is established statically from the authorization predicate and the file-server call.
The 2.2.13 tree was read, but not the 3.0.14 and 3.1.12 trees; those versions are recorded from the advisory ranges as fixed releases.
The advisory names only a 3.x commit, so the exact 2.2-branch fix commit is established from git history rather than from the advisory text.
The impact is bounded by root:: Rack::Files calls Utils.clean_path_info and File.join(@root, ...), so leading ".." segments are removed and the read cannot escape the configured root: directory.
open_questions: Whether a front-end that normalizes PATH_INFO before Rack sees it removes the attack surface in specific deployments was not audited.
